book.name: 2 Tesalonaika
book.title: 2 Tesalonaika Polho Duichon suraro Tesalonaika taun idungma ‘yuha’ yongo bapiya ngo irim togoc

content: Son ‘Kopotorocho non tongfat nehun’ yongo dönac yongitnung

Oro oröc ori, nocho mata madango ingoroc kantiwa: Son ‘nontha’ yongo dönac youp tarut. Ihoroc tuya wömai Morömahon fatmata ogepmano karupgon gurocno gurocno ongbödeangoc. Tuna owi amnaho wo kombingo gendiup. Soni tongidang ihorocnogon.
O ihorocgon owi amna koböcmaho Yesu makombing tobing imongidang worocha tongga son muyu Kopotoroc dönac inuya yuho non amna wömunohon oburodecma öcangyun möantamon.
Sontha wömai Morömaho kombing kampacmaha madongyun fatning. Muno, yuho gesö kamongo sontha gön tongga edengoc. Tuna dogu kopotho son yapmu au matong kamic.
Morömaha tongga nonu sontha irot yai matongidamon. Muno, non kombiamon, sonu nontho yong fasun fasun mata kanongidomonma worochon torocgon tanto itongidangmaho itongitnahing.
Moröma noni yu irot soni fasun kamuna sonu itong-gong soni Kopotorocha bogingmuya Duicho mepmo sumbodidocma worochon toroc sonu ihorocgon mepmodec koing songga iditnahing.
Amna ambaracho inoin oburodec youp tongga iditnung

Oröc ori, Moröma noni Yesu Duic yuhon madec wömai nonu mata orongi ingoroc kanamon: Amna au yu nontho yong fasun fasun mata noni masumbi koroc korogo ida youp au matuyai wömai woroc, sonu amna wo dou fauya yuot kondongu itninga.
Son urop kombiang, nontho sonot idomonan bongono wocin wömai non komanang maididomon, muno sinom. Worocha wömai sonu nonthon toroc kiap noni tanmuya youp tongga iditnung.

Nontho sonot itmanaina nacno au komongu mafogididomon. Muno, nonu nacno wo mönengdec wöngidomon. Nontho wömai ‘amna au sondecma mepmo imoninyit’ yongo kumbongu o apmanohu obu nonidec youp morö tongidomon.
Boinno, nontho ogep nacno manomano obusonidec komanang fogitnam mahong nonu ‘toroc kiap ogepma sontho ningo tarut’ yongo ihoroc togomon.
Nontho sonot idomonan wömai non nongoru ingoroc kanogomon: ‘Amna au yu youpno mati idai wömai yui nacno manaun.’

Worochoi oro, nonu sonthon fat soni ingoroc kombiamon: Sondecma amna auho koroc koroc yongga ididang. Yui inoin itonggongno angit sinom mayangtorengidang mahong yu amna auhon manomanohai kombingmuya yong fandada mata toup yongöang.
Oro amna ihorocnoha wömai nonu Moröma Yesu Duic yuhon madec nongoru ingo inona: Yu muyu inoin itonggongno tobingga inoin obudec youp tongmuya wocinma nacno nongitnung.
Oro oröcnai, son toroc kiap ogepma gacigon tongitnung.
Oro amna au yu nontho yong fasun fasun mata ngo irim tamonma wo matarunai wömai woroc, sonu amna worochon itonggongno acacho ida yuot kondonggon itninga. Son ihoroc tuya wömai yu yangam fap tup.
Wohong sontho yu auya yu ayam soni simbang icha. Muno, yu woi oröc soni itac. Wohai sontho ‘yu irotno ibarun’ yongo garac mata inarut.
Irot ogep mata
Oro irot guchon Morömo yu irot soni tun guc mauna son yapmu auha kombingbanac matoning, öngahu o bongono muno, Morömaho sonot itun.
Noc Pol, nakaho irot ogep mata ngo nakain obunadec irim tat. Tuna sonu wo angmuya kombiantang, boinno, bapiya ngo Pol ino sinompho togoc yo. Nakain obu irimnahon weranna ingoroc.
Moröma noni Yesu Duic yuhon banac banacnoho sonot itun.
